name: demo-project
description: Demo Project - Modern Photography Management Full-Stack SaaS

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:masteradmin: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix MasterAdmin/MasterAdmin-Backend-main" "npm run dev --prefix MasterAdmin/MasterAdmin-Frontend-main"
scripts.dev:preproduction: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix PREPRODUCTION/BACKEND-PREPRODUCTION-main" "npm run dev --prefix PREPRODUCTION/FRONTEND-PREPRODUCTION-main"
scripts.dev:sales: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix SALES/SALES-BACKEND-main" "npm run dev --prefix SALES/SALES-FRONTEND-main"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "DEMO-API,DEMO-UI,SALES-API,SALES-UI,MASTER-API,MASTER-UI,PREPROD-API,PREPROD-UI" -c "blue,cyan,yellow,green,magenta,gray,red,white" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix SALES/SALES-BACKEND-main" "npm run dev --prefix SALES/SALES-FRONTEND-main" "npm run dev --prefix MasterAdmin/MasterAdmin-Backend-main" "npm run dev --prefix MasterAdmin/MasterAdmin-Frontend-main" "npm run dev --prefix PREPRODUCTION/BACKEND-PREPRODUCTION-main" "npm run dev --prefix PREPRODUCTION/FRONTEND-PREPRODUCTION-main"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
